title: Async Replay Vision activity fails first attempt after DB connection drop
answers: Replay Vision observation has no thumbnail after a database connection drop
First attempt of async Temporal activity fails with dead/closed Django DB connection
Why does track_activity evict stale connections only for sync activities?
body:
Symptom: An observation permanently lacks a thumbnail (or an async activity's first attempt always errors) after a Postgres connection was dropped; nothing retries the thumbnail later since the backfill sweep was removed.
Root cause: products/replay_vision/backend/temporal/decorators.py:track_activity only called close_stale_db_connections in the sync wrapper; async_wrapper left dead connections on the long-lived thread.
Fix pattern: in async_wrapper, run `await sync_to_async(close_stale_db_connections)()` before invoking the activity, guarded by `if not settings.TEST`.
Constraints: Applies to every async activity decorated with track_activity. The settings.TEST skip mirrors close_db_connections (touches Django connections in tests without DB access), so the eviction itself is untested. Does not help with multi-minute Postgres outages.
applies: Replay Vision Temporal activities decorated with track_activity
says: Replay Video observation permanently stuck without thumbnail after connection drops
Activity first attempt fails and never retries following database disconnection
Async task stalls with dead database connection after network reset
search: Async Replay Vision activities decorated with track_activity (products/replay_vision/backend/temporal/decorators.py) fail on their first attempt after a Postgres connection drop because async_wrapper never called close_stale_db_connections, leaving dead connections on the long-lived thread. Fix by invoking await sync_to_async(close_stale_db_connections)() before the activity, guarded by if not settings.TEST. The settings.TEST skip mirrors close_db_connections behavior and remains untested; this pattern does not help with multi-minute Postgres outages. Applies to all async track_activity decorated activities in Replay Vision Temporal.
